service_categories.title: Water analysis
service_categories.note: Raw, tower, chilled, closed-loop, boiler, pretreatment, polisher, and condensate testing.
service_categories.description: See what is in your water and get a clearer next step for the treatment program.
service_categories.what_you_send: The water sample, system location, and result you need.
service_categories.what_you_receive: The selected chemistry or biological result tied to the submitted sample.
service_categories.timing: Most water results arrive 5–10 business days after the sample reaches the lab. Rush work may be available.
service_categories.seo_description: Compare MASEST water analysis services for raw, cooling-tower, chilled, boiler, feed, condensate, pretreatment, and polished water.

service_categories.title: Biological testing
service_categories.note: Biological counts, Legionella culture, Legionella PCR, and biological identification.
service_categories.description: Measure biological activity and identify what may be growing in the system.
service_categories.what_you_send: The water or deposit sample, system location, and biological question you need answered.
service_categories.what_you_receive: The selected count, PCR result, culture and species identification, or biological identification.
service_categories.timing: Most biological results arrive 5–10 business days after the sample reaches the lab. Rush work may be available.
service_categories.seo_description: Compare biological counts, Legionella culture, Legionella PCR, and biological identification services for industrial water systems.

service_categories.title: Materials testing
service_categories.note: Corrosion samples, pipe sections, buildup, and material checks.
service_categories.description: Learn what buildup, pipe, or a corrosion sample says about the equipment problem.
service_categories.what_you_send: The corrosion coupon, pipe section, deposit, or material sample named by the selected test.
service_categories.what_you_receive: The measurements, photos, composition, or reported element or ion result listed by the selected service.
service_categories.timing: Sample requirements, schedule, and final price are confirmed before work starts.
service_categories.seo_description: Compare corrosion coupon, pipe, deposit, particle, ICP, and IC testing services for industrial equipment and water-system problems.

service_categories.title: Consulting
service_categories.note: Equipment inspections, ultrasonic and borescope testing, sprinkler testing, and particle work.
service_categories.description: Get experienced eyes, useful measurements, and a clear path forward for an equipment problem.
service_categories.what_you_send: The equipment, system, sample, or facility question and the decision your team needs to make.
service_categories.what_you_receive: Measurements, photos, observations, or a clear next step, depending on the selected service.
service_categories.timing: Scope, access, schedule, and final price are confirmed before work starts.
service_categories.seo_description: Compare MASEST consulting, equipment inspection, ultrasonic, borescope, sprinkler, microscope, and particle-analysis services.

service_categories.title: Bid support
service_categories.note: Specification writing, review, and help during vendor interviews.
service_categories.description: Write a stronger bid, ask sharper questions, and compare vendors on what matters to your operation.
service_categories.what_you_send: Your system needs, draft specification, bid response, or vendor questions.
service_categories.what_you_receive: A water-treatment specification, bid-review findings, or vendor-interview support, depending on the selected service.
service_categories.timing: Documents, decision date, schedule, and final price are confirmed before work starts.
service_categories.seo_description: Get water-treatment bid specification writing, bid review, and vendor interview support from MASEST.

service_categories.title: Field services
service_categories.note: On-site sample collection and standard sampling visits.
service_categories.description: Have MASEST collect and deliver samples so your test starts with reliable field work.
service_categories.what_you_send: The site, system, access requirements, and tests or samples needed.
service_categories.what_you_receive: Labeled samples routed to testing with a clear sample record.
service_categories.timing: Site access, travel, schedule, and final price are confirmed before work starts.
service_categories.seo_description: Plan professional on-site water sample collection, labeling, records, and routing to the selected laboratory tests.

service_categories.title: Water management
service_categories.note: ASHRAE 188 assessment, plan writing, renewal, and dashboard access.
service_categories.description: Build a practical water plan around your facility, systems, team, and day-to-day work.
service_categories.what_you_send: Your building, water systems, team roles, current plan or records, and the result needed.
service_categories.what_you_receive: The selected risk assessment, plan, certification, dashboard, renewal, or review output.
service_categories.timing: Facility scope, records, access, schedule, and final price are confirmed before work starts.
service_categories.seo_description: Compare ASHRAE 188 risk assessment, water management plan development, certification, dashboard, renewal, and review services.

service_categories.title: Packages
service_categories.note: Bundled initial sampling, annual setup, quarterly audit, and yearly recertification.
service_categories.description: Bundle sampling, planning, audits, and annual support into one easier engagement.
service_categories.what_you_send: Your building, systems, sample needs, current program, and annual support goal.
service_categories.what_you_receive: The visit, sampling, lab testing, planning, audit, or recertification deliverables listed in the selected package.
service_categories.timing: Package scope, access, schedule, and final price are confirmed before work starts.
service_categories.seo_title: Water Testing & WMP Service Packages | MASEST
service_categories.seo_description: Compare bundled MASEST sampling, laboratory testing, water management plan setup, quarterly audit, and yearly recertification packages.

services.name: Raw Water - Standard Analysis
services.summary: See what is in your incoming water and get a clear baseline for treatment decisions.

services.name: Tower Water - Standard + Bio Counts
services.summary: See the chemistry and biological activity in your cooling-tower water so you can tune the program with confidence.

services.name: Chill Water - Standard + Bio Counts
services.summary: Check chilled-water chemistry and biological activity before small issues become expensive system problems.

services.name: Closed Loop Water - Standard + Bio Counts
services.summary: Check closed-loop water chemistry and biological activity to keep the system clean, stable, and protected.

services.name: Steam Boiler Water - Standard
services.summary: See how your boiler water is performing and where the treatment program may need attention.

services.name: Pretreatment Water (Soft/Degas)
services.summary: Check softened or degasified pretreatment water before it reaches the boiler system.

services.name: Boiler Feed Water - Standard
services.summary: Check boiler-feed water quality to catch scale and corrosion risks before they reach the boiler.

services.name: Polisher Water - Standard
services.summary: Confirm how well the polishing step is cleaning the water and spot breakthrough early.

services.name: Steam Condensate - Standard
services.summary: Check steam condensate quality and see what the return system is sending back to the boiler.

services.name: Biological Counts (HPC/dip-slide)
services.summary: Track biological activity with an HPC or dip-slide count and see whether the water program is staying on course.

services.name: Legionella - Full Culture + Specie ID
services.summary: Find out whether Legionella is present and which species the lab identifies through full culture testing.

services.name: Legionella - PCR Pos/Neg
services.summary: Get a fast positive-or-negative PCR result for Legionella in the submitted water sample.

services.name: Biological Identifications
services.summary: Identify the biological growth found in a water or deposit sample and get a clearer picture of the system problem.

services.name: Corrosion Coupon Analysis (incl. photo)
services.summary: See how much corrosion occurred during the exposure period, with measurements, condition notes, and photos.

services.name: Pipe Analysis (Deposit + Measurements + Photos)
services.summary: See what built up inside a pipe section, how the pipe changed, and what the measurements and photos reveal.

services.name: Deposit Analysis - Standard
services.summary: Learn what a deposit contains so you can choose a better cleaning or treatment approach.

services.name: Single Element Analysis (ICP or IC)
services.summary: Measure one target element by ICP or IC and get a clear reported result for the submitted sample.

services.name: Abbreviated Analysis (ICP or IC)
services.summary: Screen a sample for selected elements or ions with a focused ICP or IC report.

services.name: Water Treatment Bid Specification Creation
services.summary: Turn your system needs into a clear water-treatment bid specification that vendors can answer and your team can compare.

services.name: Water Treatment Bid Review
services.summary: Find gaps, vague requirements, and hidden cost risks in a water-treatment bid before your team makes a decision.

services.name: Water Treatment Bid Interview
services.summary: Prepare sharper vendor questions, keep the interview focused, and leave with clearer answers for the buying decision.

services.name: Consulting Services (general)
services.summary: Work through one water, cleaning, or facility decision with a MASEST specialist and leave with a clear next step.

services.name: Equipment Inspections
services.summary: Get an experienced look at equipment condition, supported by measurements, photos, and practical findings.

services.name: Ultrasonic / Borescope Testing
services.summary: Look inside hard-to-reach equipment and measure material condition with ultrasonic or borescope testing.

services.name: Scanning Electron Microscope Testing
services.summary: See fine surface and deposit details through high-magnification microscope images and clear observations.

services.name: Sprinkler System Testing
services.summary: Check sprinkler-system water and condition, document the results, and identify problems that need attention.

services.name: Particle Size Analysis
services.summary: Measure the size range and distribution of particles in the submitted sample.

services.name: Particle Size Analysis + Particle ID
services.summary: Measure particle size and identify what the particles are to narrow down where they came from.

services.name: On-Site Sample Collection (travel quoted)
services.summary: Have MASEST collect, label, and route site samples so the testing starts with a clean, reliable handoff.

services.name: On-Site Sampling Fee (standard visit)
services.summary: Add professional on-site sample collection to a standard visit, complete with a clear sample record.

services.name: Risk Assessment (ASHRAE 188)
services.summary: Find the water-system risks in your building and prioritize the controls your team needs under ASHRAE 188.

services.name: WMP Development (ASHRAE 188)
services.summary: Get a practical Water Management Plan built around your building, systems, team, controls, and review schedule.

services.name: Plan Certification
services.summary: Have MASEST review your plan against the project requirements and issue a clear written statement of the result.

services.name: Plan Renewal (annual)
services.summary: Keep the plan current with an annual review of system changes, records, findings, and follow-up actions.

services.name: Monthly Dashboard Access
services.summary: See monthly water-program records, monitoring status, alerts, and follow-up work in one dashboard.

service_packages.name: Initial Sampling Visit Package
service_packages.summary: Start with an on-site visit, professional sample collection, and the lab tests your building needs most.

service_packages.name: Water Management Plan Setup (annual)
service_packages.summary: Launch a building-specific Water Management Plan with risk review, plan development, team handoff, and first-year support.

service_packages.name: Quarterly Audit
service_packages.summary: Review the program every quarter, catch gaps early, and leave each audit with a clear action list and owners.

service_packages.name: Yearly Recertification
service_packages.summary: Give the program an annual checkup, update the plan, and receive a written MASEST review statement.
